title: 2^{Omega(n)} hardness of Euclidean SVP under ETH
credit: Aggarwal, Gupta, Morolia, Zhang, 'Mind the Gap? Not for SVP Hardness under ETH!', ICALP 2026 (LIPIcs 374, paper 8), arXiv:2504.02695, Open Problem 1.
plain: Show that approximate SVP in the l_2 norm (some constant gamma>1) has no 2^{o(n)}-time algorithm unless (randomized) ETH fails; or identify an obstruction (e.g. for the Z^n-based gadget) showing the l_p, p>2 technique cannot reach p=2.
math: Prove there is a constant gamma>1 such that, unless randomized ETH fails, no 2^{o(n)}-time randomized algorithm solves gamma-GapSVP in the l_2 norm on rank-n lattices. Alternatively, prove that the AGMZ approach (Z^n gadget + Theta-function inequality, valid for p>2) provably fails at p=2.
lean_gap: Not formalized: needs time-bounded randomized computation, GapSVP promise problems, and randomized ETH, none in Mathlib. Only the main (hardness) question would be formalized; the 'technique obstruction' alternative is not a theorem-level statement.
